name: Valeria Steelheart
description: A veteran mercenary with unyielding spirit. Her relentless assault breaks through even the toughest defenses.

name: Knight-Commander Roderic
description: A stalwart defender who leads from the front. His shield is said to be unbreakable.

name: Enchantress Mira
description: A mysterious magician wielding forbidden arcane arts. Her spells distort reality itself.

name: Celestine the Luminary
description: A wandering supporter who empowers allies with radiant blessings. Essential for sustained campaigns.

name: Fenris Wolfbane
description: A feral warrior who channels beast instincts in combat. Fast and deadly up close.

name: Stonewall Brunhild
description: A dependable defender who holds the line. Easy to recruit and raise.

name: Pyromancer Cinder
description: A fire mage with explosive potential. Great area damage for early game content.
